reply_body: Sorry the app hasn't worked for you. I'd like to know what exactly broke — crashes, orders not going through, or something else — so we can get it fixed rather than leave you stuck. Your account and the recent renewal are going to our billing team for a review, and you'll hear back on that. If you can send a screenshot or the error you saw, that will speed things up.
summary: User says app does not work and demands money back, threatening a 1-star public review; no specific fault described.
